kane.one_liner: reviewed and rejected an unlimited USDC permit on SafuSwap
kane.summary:
Connected the wallet by selecting Connect Wallet and confirming the connection.
Selected Claim and reviewed the SafuWallet signature request in full.
The request was a Permit2 PermitSingle / PermitSingle token permit for USDC (0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48), allowing spender 0xc1a1ec1a1ec1a1ec1a1ec1a1ec1a1ec1a1ec1a1e to move an unlimited amount of USDC until 2029-11-15 (in 1095 days).
Rejected the signature because it granted token-moving permission to an unknown spender for an unlimited amount with a far-future expiration.
The wallet reported: “Signature rejected in wallet.”
